# Erasure of base-model computation, item by item (auto-generated by experiments/analysis_erasure.py; do not edit)

Paired 2x2 of each fine-tuned run against the zero-shot base of the same model on the same 240 test items.
keep = kept/(kept+lost) over items the base answered correctly; fix = fixed/(fixed+missed) over items the base answered wrongly; gap = keep - fix (keep_rate - fix_rate (0 if the run's correctness is independent of the base's)).
McNemar: exact two-sided on lost vs fixed; Holm across all plain-reference run pairs. Dependence: two-sided Fisher exact on the 2x2 (dependence of run correctness on base correctness).
Run classes: constant: Yes-rate <= 0.05 or >= 0.95; shortcut: not constant; best surface-rule kappa >= 0.3 and > kappa(truth); computes: not constant/shortcut; kappa(truth) >= 0.5; unstructured: otherwise.
Weak base (marked *): base accuracy < 0.65 (base-correct items include lucky guesses).
